channel.title: Chain Times
channel.description: Chain Times reports crypto news: bitcoin and ether markets, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: Token Approval Revocation: Checking the Allowance
item.description: To check if a token approval was revoked, wait for confirmation, then read the ERC-20 allowance for your wallet and spender on the same network; zero means none remains.

item.title: Sent transaction: Why Etherscan can’t find it yet
item.description: Why does a sent transaction not show up on Etherscan? A hash can exist before any node accepts it; private routing can keep it off the public tracker.

item.title: Bridge relayer after tokens are locked: how delivery works
item.description: What does a bridge relayer do after tokens are locked? It waits for finality and attestation, then submits the message that completes delivery.

item.title: How to Revoke Token Approvals in MetaMask After Trading to Zero
item.description: How to revoke token approvals in MetaMask after trading: submit a zero-allowance transaction through a chain-compatible approval manager, then verify it.

item.title: deBridge vs Across: Pick the Cheaper Route for This Transfer
item.description: deBridge vs Across: Across usually costs less for small, same-token moves; deBridge can win on large transfers or swaps. Compare live quotes by amount received.

item.title: Polygon bridge: how transfers work and what to check
item.description: Polygon bridge explained for beginners: it locks supported tokens on Ethereum and mints matching tokens on Polygon PoS, then reverses the process for withdrawals.

item.title: Short liquidity locks: match the term to your holding period
item.description: A short liquidity lock restricts LP withdrawal only until its release time, so compare the time left with your planned holding period to judge token rug risk.

item.title: US gets court order over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: A US court order now lets authorities seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion from the Binance theft, while efforts to trace and recover the rest continue.

item.title: How to Verify a Solana Mint Authority Is Revoked
item.description: To check if Solana mint authority has been revoked, read the exact mint’s decoded field: None or null means absent; a public key means it remains assigned.

item.title: Choose a Fraxswap Pool When Token Risk Differs
item.description: How to choose a liquidity pool before providing liquidity: compare turnover, reserves and token risk, then start with an amount you can leave exposed.

item.title: What happens inside a Fraxswap pair: follow your tokens
item.description: What happens inside a Fraxswap pair contract during a swap? Pending TWAMM orders shift reserves first; the pair then sends output and checks the fee-adjusted invariant.

item.title: Token allowance vs token balance: ERC-20 accounting
item.description: Token allowance vs token balance: a balance is what an address holds; an allowance is a spender’s remaining authority over those tokens under an ERC-20 contract.

item.title: What Is a Liquidity Pool, and How Does It Work?
item.description: A liquidity pool in DeFi is a smart contract holding tokens for swaps. Learn how its price formula works and what LP tokens represent.

item.title: US gets authority to seize $1.2B in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, part of a wider recovery effort.

item.title: US moves to seize or restrain $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized the seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the Binance theft, as efforts to trace the funds continue.

item.title: DOJ gets court authority over $1.2B in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, within $2.7 billion already frozen so far.

item.title: How to follow a Monad bridge transfer from start to finish
item.description: How does Monad bridge work? A source contract locks or burns assets, a messaging layer attests to the transfer, and a destination contract releases or mints them.

item.title: Revoke.cash Browser Extension: Simulation Before Signing
item.description: What does the revokecash browser extension do? It simulates proposed transactions and warns before signing; use the site to review and revoke old allowances.

item.title: US wins court approval over $1.2B in Binance theft funds
item.description: The Justice Department says a court approved seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in crypto from the Binance theft, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: US gets court approval over $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US prosecutors won court approval to seize or restrain over $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen as recovery efforts continue.
